messages:
Nora (Design): quick check for Pools bulk-delete UX: when some rows fail (locked/perm issues), do we show errors inline per row or a single top summary with links? trying to avoid visual noise but keep keyboard & screen reader flows tidy. Ivy (PM): i'm leaning summary panel + anchors. Users doing bulk ops want a single place to scan failures. anchors can jump to the row for context. :thumbsup: Cal (Eng): summary + anchors is fine. engineering note: when submit returns failures we should move focus to the summary and ensure tab order is predictable so keyboard users don't get lost. Jon (DevEx): agree. also show collapsed inline details for the first 2 fails in the list so folks can see context without jumping. keep collapsible so large lists stay compact. Nora (Design): for screen readers, should the summary auto-expand the first item when focused, or just provide links? a11y-bot: recommended pattern: move focus to a status container with role="status" and aria-live="polite" announcing the count. Provide links with aria-controls that reveal per-row regions. Example: ```n
3 items failed to delete
\nOpen details for row 9\n
Locked: resource in use
\n``` Cal (Eng): nice. implementation detail: when user activates an anchor, expand the row detail inline and move focus to its heading. ensure there is a skip-back link to return to the summary. Jon (DevEx): keyboard acceptance: pressing tab after submit should land on the first actionable in the summary (the first anchor). ESC closes any expanded detail. we should document this in the PR checklist. Nora (Design): second topic: typed-confirm vs checkbox for destructive deletes. typed-confirm reduces mistakes but can slow down power users. thoughts on conditional rules? Ivy (PM): propose conditional typed-confirm for org-owned pools or pools with >25 members. default to checkbox+strong warning for small/personal pools. Cal (Eng): if typed-confirm is used: autofocus input, allow paste, set autocomplete=\"off\", disable primary CTA until exact match. decide on case sensitivity: i'd prefer trimmed, case-sensitive match for safety. Jon (DevEx): agree on disabling CTA until match, show inline validation like "Names do not match." Use aria-invalid when mismatch and aria-describedby to point to helper text. ESC should close modal and focus returns to the trigger. Nora (Design): copy tweak: instead of "Type the pool name to confirm" -> "Enter the pool name to permanently delete this pool." adds gravity. a11y-bot: also recommend visible focus outline on the typed input and announcing validation state changes in the same aria-live region. Provide concise error copy like "Names do not match." Ivy (PM): decision summary proposal: 1) Bulk errors: top summary (aria-live, focus moved there) + anchors + inline collapsed previews for first 2 failures. 2) Typed-confirm: opt-in for org-owned or >25 members; when enabled, autofocus input, autocomplete=off, disable CTA until trimmed exact match, allow paste. 3) Microcopy: use "permanently delete" phrasing. Cal (Eng): ack. i'll file focus-management tickets and implement anchor/expand behavior. will follow trimmed, case-sensitive matching unless PM requests otherwise. Jon (DevEx): i'll add keyboard/a11y acceptance criteria to the PR template and include tests for aria-live, aria-controls, and ESC behavior. Nora (Design): i'll post mocks that show the summary+collapsed inline details and the typed-confirm modal copy change. tagging @Cal @Jon @Ivy for quick review when up. Ivy (PM): thanks everyone, i'll update the spec with the conditional typed-confirm rule and rollout notes. Cal (Eng): will review mocks.
